meta.title: Mobile MACD — SIM Swap Journey — Process Flow

lanes.name: Retail Agent
lanes.hint: Customer verification, cart, form, payment, submission

lanes.name: Approver
lanes.hint: Agent Task View / Agent Approval View

lanes.name: DXP / Order Fulfilment / Systems
lanes.hint: WinCash, UIM, Order Fulfilment, Notification, Audit

nodes.label: SIM Swap Journey Initiated
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (JSM) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Optional Soft ID Scan for Plan Change
nodes.desc: The system shall offer soft ID scanning only when the customer proceeds with a plan change after retention.

nodes.label: Mandatory Lightweight Customer Verification
nodes.desc: The system shall perform lightweight customer verification using CAV before the MACD journey progresses.
outputs: Verification result recorded before assignment/eligibility activity

nodes.label: Search Customer
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to search customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.

nodes.label: Initiate SIM Swap Journey
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to initiate a SIM Swap order.

nodes.label: Cart Creation (SIM Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (SIM) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Capture SIM Swap Reason
nodes.desc: The system shall require SIM Swap reason to be captured before order submission.
controls: BR-SIM-001: SIM Swap reason mandatory before submission

nodes.label: Capture Replacement SIM Details
nodes.desc: The system shall capture replacement SIM details for SIM Swap.
controls: BR-SIM-002: Replacement SIM details mandatory before order submission
outputs: Replacement SIM Serial Number or ICCID captured against the order

nodes.label: Checkout (CVC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CVC) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Cart Discount
nodes.desc: System shall overwrite and apply latest valid discount available in cart based on the plan selection.
outputs: Latest discount applied based on plan selection

nodes.label: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
nodes.desc: Third milestone in the source Requirements sheet: Cart Checked Out. No requirement row is attached to this milestone in the source.

nodes.label: Capture SIM Swap Form
nodes.desc: The system shall require SIM Swap request form or signature evidence to be attached for approval validation.
controls: BR-SIM-003: SIM Swap form/signature evidence mandatory for approval validation

nodes.label: Milestone: SIM Swap Form
nodes.desc: Fourth milestone in the source Requirements sheet: SIM Swap Form. No requirement row is attached to this milestone in the source.

nodes.label: Payment (PAY Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (PAY) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).
controls: BR-SIM-004: WinCash reused for SIM Swap payment/receipt; charge rule — lost SIM chargeable, faulty SIM free, eSIM free, eSIM-to-physical chargeable

nodes.label: Physical SIM Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: The system shall deplete a Physical SIM or a Printed eSIM from stock through WinCash on payment completion.
controls: BR-SIM-007: Physical SIM and Printed eSIM depleted within WinCash; Virtual eSIM depleted within UIM
outputs: SIM stock position within WinCash reduced by one

nodes.label: Virtual eSIM Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: Since Virtual eSIM is not allocated to store and the inventory is not maintained at WinCash, eSIM depletion will happen at order fulfilment stage.
controls: BR-SIM-007: Physical SIM and Printed eSIM depleted within WinCash; Virtual eSIM depleted within UIM
outputs: Virtual eSIM marked consumed within UIM at order fulfilment stage; no WinCash depletion attempted

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to submit the order once all sections are filled and saved and payment has completed.
outputs: Submit action enabled only when all sections complete and payment status is paid

nodes.label: Milestone: Order Submitted
nodes.desc: Fifth milestone in the source Requirements sheet: Order Submitted. No requirement row is attached to this milestone in the source.

nodes.label: Agent Task View (ATV Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ATV) as detailed in Agent 360 (AGN_AGT_360_RET_001).

nodes.label: Agent Approval View (AAV Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (AAV) as detailed in Agent 360 (AGN_AGT_360_RET_001).

nodes.label: Restrict Agent Action While Pending
nodes.desc: The system shall prevent agents from submitting or dropping SIM Swap orders in pending approval state.
controls: BR-SIM-005: Agent shall not submit or drop orders in pending approval state
outputs: Only approver can approve or reject an order in pending approval state

nodes.label: Milestone: SIM Swap Request Approved
nodes.desc: Final milestone in the source Requirements sheet: SIM Swap Request Approved. No requirement row is attached to this milestone in the source.

nodes.label: Order Fulfilment (ORD Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ORD) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (NOT) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001). For WFM activities, Feedback & Survey will be done separately at the WFM system.

nodes.label: Audit Trail (AUD Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (AUD) as detailed in Trouble Ticket (TT-001).
controls: BR-SIM-006: SIM Swap approval/rejection activity created in the system for audit trail

nodes.label: End of Order Capture Journey
nodes.desc: Terminal milestone in the source Requirements sheet closing the SIM Swap order capture journey.

start.title: SIM Swap Journey Initiated
start.does: Starts the SIM Swap MACD journey, reusing the Journey and Session Management (JSM) capability from the Mobile Post Paid Activation journey.
start.needs: Agent authorisation and journey/session context (per MPAR_001_JSM_*).
start.makes: An active journey/session for the SIM Swap request.
start.example: Retail agent opens the SIM Swap journey for a walk-in customer.

kyc_soft_id.title: Optional Soft ID Scan for Plan Change
kyc_soft_id.does: Offers soft ID scanning only when the customer proceeds with a plan change after retention.
kyc_soft_id.needs: Customer proceeding with a plan change after retention.
kyc_soft_id.makes: A recorded soft ID scan completion when invoked.
kyc_soft_id.example: Customer opts for a plan change after a retention conversation; agent performs a soft ID scan.

cav_verify.title: Mandatory Lightweight Customer Verification
cav_verify.does: Performs lightweight customer verification (CAV) before the MACD journey progresses.
cav_verify.needs: Customer present/reachable for a lightweight verification question.
cav_verify.makes: A verification result recorded before assignment or eligibility activity.
cav_verify.example: Agent asks the customer a verification question before proceeding with SIM Swap.

cam_search.title: Search Customer
cam_search.does: Lets the agent search for the customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and displays Customer 360.
cam_search.needs: One or more search inputs from the agent.
cam_search.makes: Customer 360 view displayed for the matched customer.
cam_search.example: Agent searches by MSISDN and Customer 360 opens.

cam_initiate.title: Initiate SIM Swap Journey
cam_initiate.does: Lets the agent initiate a SIM Swap order from Customer 360.
cam_initiate.makes: A SIM Swap order raised for the customer.
cam_initiate.example: Agent clicks 'SIM Swap' from Customer 360 to start the order.

sim_ref.title: Cart Creation (SIM Capability Reuse)
sim_ref.does: Follows the same SIM Management (SIM) capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey for cart creation.
sim_ref.makes: A cart set up for the SIM Swap order.
sim_ref.example: Cart is created for the SIM Swap request per the reused SIM capability.

sim_reason.title: Capture SIM Swap Reason
sim_reason.does: Requires the SIM Swap reason to be captured before order submission.
sim_reason.needs: Agent selection/entry of the SIM Swap reason.
sim_reason.makes: SIM Swap reason recorded on the order (BR-SIM-001).
sim_reason.example: Agent selects 'Lost SIM' as the reason before the order can be submitted.

sim_replacement.title: Capture Replacement SIM Details
sim_replacement.does: Captures replacement SIM details for the SIM Swap.
sim_replacement.needs: Replacement SIM Serial Number or ICCID.
sim_replacement.makes: Replacement SIM identifier captured against the order (BR-SIM-002).
sim_replacement.example: Agent scans or enters the new SIM's ICCID.

cvc_ref.title: Checkout (CVC Capability Reuse)
cvc_ref.does: Follows the same Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC) capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey.
cvc_ref.needs: Cart populated with SIM Swap details.
cvc_ref.makes: Cart validated and ready for checkout.
cvc_ref.example: Cart validation runs the same checks as the postpaid activation journey's CVC capability.

cvc_discount.title: Cart Discount
cvc_discount.does: Overwrites and applies the latest valid discount available in the cart based on the plan selection.
cvc_discount.makes: Latest applicable discount applied to the cart.
cvc_discount.example: A newer discount for the selected plan replaces a stale one already in the cart.

milestone_cart_checked_out.title: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
milestone_cart_checked_out.does: Marks the point in the source Requirements sheet where the cart has been checked out (Third Milestone).
milestone_cart_checked_out.makes: A checked-out cart ready for contract/form capture.
milestone_cart_checked_out.example: Cart checkout completes and the journey proceeds to the SIM Swap form.

caf_form.title: Capture SIM Swap Form
caf_form.does: Requires the SIM Swap request form or signature evidence to be attached for approval validation.
caf_form.needs: Signed form or signature evidence from the customer.
caf_form.example: Agent uploads the signed SIM Swap form before the request can proceed to approval.

milestone_sim_swap_form.title: Milestone: SIM Swap Form
milestone_sim_swap_form.does: Marks the point in the source Requirements sheet where the SIM Swap form has been captured (Fourth Milestone).
milestone_sim_swap_form.makes: Journey ready to proceed to payment and order submission.
milestone_sim_swap_form.example: Form capture completes and the journey proceeds to payment.

pay_ref.title: Payment (PAY Capability Reuse)
pay_ref.does: Follows the same Payment and Inventory (PAY) capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey, with SIM Swap charging governed by BR-SIM-004 (lost SIM chargeable, faulty SIM free, eSIM free, eSIM-to-physical chargeable).
pay_ref.makes: Payment/receipt handled through WinCash where applicable.
pay_ref.example: System calculates the SIM Swap fee based on the swap reason per BR-SIM-004.

pay_physical_deplete.title: Physical SIM Inventory Depletion
pay_physical_deplete.does: Depletes a Physical SIM or Printed eSIM from stock through WinCash on payment completion.
pay_physical_deplete.needs: Payment completion for a physical/printed eSIM swap.
pay_physical_deplete.makes: SIM stock position within WinCash reduced by one (BR-SIM-007).
pay_physical_deplete.example: Physical SIM stock count in WinCash drops by one once payment is confirmed.

pay_virtual_deplete.title: Virtual eSIM Inventory Depletion
pay_virtual_deplete.does: Defers Virtual eSIM depletion to the order fulfilment stage since Virtual eSIM inventory is not maintained at WinCash.
pay_virtual_deplete.needs: Order reaching the fulfilment stage for a Virtual eSIM swap.
pay_virtual_deplete.makes: Virtual eSIM marked consumed within UIM at fulfilment; no WinCash depletion attempted (BR-SIM-007).
pay_virtual_deplete.example: Virtual eSIM order completes payment, then UIM marks the eSIM consumed at fulfilment.

ord_submit.title: Order Submission
ord_submit.does: Allows the Retail Agent to submit the order once all sections are filled/saved and payment has completed.
ord_submit.needs: All order sections complete and payment status paid.
ord_submit.example: Agent clicks Submit once payment is confirmed and every section is complete.

milestone_order_submitted.title: Milestone: Order Submitted
milestone_order_submitted.does: Marks the point in the source Requirements sheet where the order has been submitted (Fifth Milestone).
milestone_order_submitted.makes: Order ready for the approval task to be created.
milestone_order_submitted.example: Submitted order triggers the approval task creation step.

atv_ref.title: Agent Task View (ATV Capability Reuse)
atv_ref.does: Follows the same Agent Task View (ATV) capability as detailed in Agent 360.
atv_ref.needs: Submitted SIM Swap order requiring an approval task.
atv_ref.makes: Approval task visible in the approver's task view.
atv_ref.example: Approver sees the new SIM Swap approval task in their task list, per the Agent 360 ATV capability.

aav_ref.title: Agent Approval View (AAV Capability Reuse)
aav_ref.does: Follows the same Agent Approval View (AAV) capability as detailed in Agent 360.
aav_ref.needs: Approval task assigned to the approver.
aav_ref.makes: Approval view available for the approver to act on.
aav_ref.example: Approver opens the SIM Swap request in the Agent Approval View.

aav_restrict.title: Restrict Agent Action While Pending
aav_restrict.does: Prevents agents from submitting or dropping SIM Swap orders while the order is in pending approval state; only the approver can approve or reject.
aav_restrict.makes: Approve/reject decision recorded by the approver (BR-SIM-005).
aav_restrict.example: Originating agent cannot cancel the order while it awaits approver decision.

milestone_request_approved.title: Milestone: SIM Swap Request Approved
milestone_request_approved.does: Marks the point in the source Requirements sheet where the SIM Swap request has been approved (Final Milestone).
milestone_request_approved.makes: Order ready to proceed to the order fulfilment journey.
milestone_request_approved.example: Approved SIM Swap request proceeds to fulfilment.

ord_fulfil_ref.title: Order Fulfilment (ORD Capability Reuse)
ord_fulfil_ref.does: Follows the same Order Submission (ORD) capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey for order fulfilment.
ord_fulfil_ref.example: Approved order proceeds through the same fulfilment routing as postpaid activation orders.

not_ref.title: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
not_ref.does: Follows the same Notification and Feedback (NOT) capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey; WFM feedback/survey activities are handled separately at the WFM system.
not_ref.needs: Fulfilment milestone events to notify on.
not_ref.makes: Notifications dispatched to relevant parties; WFM handles its own feedback/survey separately.
not_ref.example: Customer receives a notification on order completion; WFM manages its own survey dispatch.

aud_trail.title: Audit Trail (AUD Capability Reuse)
aud_trail.does: Follows the same Audit Trail (AUD) capability as detailed in Trouble Ticket (TT-001); creates an audit record for approval/rejection activity.
aud_trail.needs: Approval/rejection activity on the SIM Swap order.
aud_trail.example: System logs the approver's approve/reject decision for audit purposes.

end.title: End of Order Capture Journey
end.does: Closes the SIM Swap order capture journey.
end.needs: All prior steps complete (fulfilment, notification, audit).
end.makes: SIM Swap order capture journey concluded.
end.example: Journey ends after fulfilment, notification and audit steps complete.
